task: Audit emitter expression parser counters during retained-tree migration.
observation: Two emitter parse paths were outside the existing reparsing counter: borrowed-view index inspection called parse_view directly, and named-argument projection called parse_named_argument_view directly. Routing the first through expression_view_from_est and counting the second increases accounting visibility without changing generated Rust.
impact: Prior paired consumer counts undercounted these parse sites, so historical sample deltas are not strictly comparable without matching instrumentation on the phase27-5-3-c1 baseline.
evidence: examples/collections_and_methods.moss: candidate 1,244 text lookups / 532 expression-view reparses; generated Rust identical to c96 parent

resolution.summary: Instrument the same sites in the pinned parent build before reporting a strict paired delta.

task: Lower a pipeline represented by retained EST nodes without parsing its source text.
observation: Bootstrap and source inspection found no optimizer parser entry point. In the emitter, functional_pipeline() intentionally recognizes only built-in operations, while the checker records user-named pipeline stages as ordinary call edges. Reading the retained Pipeline/Call nodes plus those checked edges allowed direct nested-call lowering without a functional plan.
impact: For mini_application.moss, native functional-pipeline reparses fell from 2 to 0 and total expression reparses fell from 6,122 to 2,018 against the counter-matched parent, with byte-identical Rust and runtime output.

resolution.summary: The checked callable-pipeline node path handles the pure local fixture shape. Other pipeline node shapes still need coverage and lowering.

task: Remove emitter parsing for checked identifier nodes.
observation: View projection already resolves representation-sensitive names; after it declines, ordinary locals and non-view domain state/route identifiers can be lowered from their retained Identifier node. The mini-application node fallback count became zero with byte-identical Rust.
impact: On the paired mini-application workload, lookups fell 9,497 -> 3,031 and expression reparses 6,122 -> 1,610 per default or optimized command. A separate member-call experiment introduced a clone and was reverted, confirming that some legacy expression paths still encode ownership decisions.

resolution.summary: Retain the identifier lowering; keep the ownership-sensitive member-call route unchanged.

task: Use checked call-edge targets for retained member-call nodes.
observation: A unique checked call edge can fill a missing member-call node target. The ordinary value-context index lowering clones indexed values, so the narrowly supported Vector/Seq method receiver path preserves method-place rendering to retain existing Rust autoref behavior.
impact: For collections_and_methods.moss, generated Rust stayed byte-identical in default and -O, while paired lookups/reparses fell 2,607/1,259 -> 855/194. The Rust compiled and execution output matched.

resolution.summary: Keep the checked target path for the tested Vector/Seq indexed method-receiver shape; other ownership-sensitive receivers remain uncovered.

task: Keep callback expression nodes alive when converting a functional pipeline through the emitter compatibility parser.
observation: ASan traced a stack-use-after-return in generated callable result handling to ParsedFunctionalPipeline retaining pointers into a local temporary EST arena. Moving arena ownership into the parsed pipeline and rebinding stage arena pointers removed the dangling lifetime.
impact: The map-call argument source emits and compiles again and prints 4 in default and optimized modes. Fast Debug still fails on the same source on both C1 and candidate due to its existing missing checked-node invariant.

resolution.summary: Parsed compatibility pipelines retain shared ownership of their temporary arena; Fast Debug failure is baseline debt outside this emitter change.

task: Route assignment RHS shape queries through the checked expression handle.
observation: Using the retained RHS node for empty-constructor and identifier shape checks removes those text-fingerprint lookups on assignment lowering. A targeted optimized functional fixture showed only a small aggregate lookup decrease and no parse decrease, so the broader reparse count is dominated by other string-based consumers.
impact: On examples/functional_semantic_optimization.moss -O, text-node lookups decreased 991 to 986 while native expression-view reparses remained 758. Six assignment-heavy fixtures compiled in default and -O, and the fact-hook and three-engine tests passed.

resolution.summary: Keep the typed RHS shape accessors and continue migrating string-based expression consumers; the targeted result is not evidence of broad K2 progress.

task: Move string mutation and functional statement queries onto retained expression nodes.
observation: The node-based String builtin path removes repeated fallback reparses while preserving the generated Rust and native result. Reusing checked initializer/return handles also reduces text lookups on representative statements.
impact: Against the C1 test build on identical optimized commands, phase24_string_concat decreased 5,775 lookups/2,138 reparses to 1,624/356; collections_and_methods decreased 2,607/1,247 to 843/194; phase45_cross_let_result decreased 641/467 to 208/163. Rust and stdout parity passed on the string fixtures.

resolution.summary: Keep the migrated node paths; continue measuring the full corpus because substantial emitter string consumers remain.

task: Reuse checked receiver and call nodes in native statement lowering.
observation: Two statement method receiver type queries now use the retained receiver ExprId, and an intrinsic receiver call uses its checked call expression rather than synthesizing receiver.method(args) text. In the calculator sample this reduced string type queries by 124 and text-node lookups by 210 while the generated Rust output remained equal to Fast Debug.
impact: These changes reduce emitter text lookups on the measured sample, but expression-view reparses remain unchanged at 15,804 per default command; the phase target of zero is not close on this workload.

resolution.summary: Keep the retained-node routes and continue tracing the dominant string query sites; do not claim corpus-wide progress from this single source.

task: Use checked statement call targets for exact retained member-call roots.
observation: The checker had retained builtin receiver-call targets on Stmt::checked_call_targets_by_context, but the node emitter only consulted node facts and semantic call edges. Mapping the exact statement expression handle to that checked target fixed the source-free generic Range build without type-based target reconstruction. The same receiver-place helper no longer selects custom methods by receiver type.
impact: Team A source-free provider rebuild passes again and the call-target perturb/drop suite remains green. Receiver-call target access is now rooted in checker facts for this path.

resolution.summary: Keep this exact-root target handoff. The implicit iterator methods in for lowering remain separate checker-authority work.

task: Exercise call-target perturbation and removal on a direct receiver method call.
observation: The indexed receiver fixture already exercised xs[i].m(); adding a small x.m() fixture made the call-target hook suite cover both direct and indexed receiver shapes. Both cases fail closed under native emission and Fast Debug when the checked target is perturbed or dropped.
impact: The registered hook harness now passes seven call-target fixtures, including both receiver forms, across Fast Debug, native and -O. The direct fixture emits valid Rust and prints 42.

resolution.summary: Keep both receiver shapes in call-target perturbation and fail-closed coverage.

task: Project root simple-call shapes from the retained emitter node.
observation: When EmitterExpr lowering falls through to compatibility lowering, its root simple-call checks can project the already-retained call node instead of performing a text-keyed EST lookup.
impact: On the targeted calculator source, text-node lookups decreased 22,836 to 22,760; expression-view reparses stayed 15,360. Generated Rust was byte-identical to the previous sample, Rust compilation passed, and native/Fast Debug stdout matched.

resolution.summary: Keep the root projection and continue migrating compatibility lowering; this slice reduces lookups but does not lower reparse count.

task: Project compatibility-lowering unary and grouping shape from retained roots.
observation: When compatibility lowering has an EmitterExpr, root unary and identifier classification can use its node directly; outer grouping can be stripped by selecting the unparenthesized ExprId and taking that node slice.
impact: On the same calculator source, text-node lookups decreased from 22,760 to 22,380, while expression-view reparses stayed at 15,360. Generated Rust remained byte-identical; Rust compilation, native/Fast Debug stdout parity and checked-fact perturb/drop hooks passed.

resolution.summary: Keep the retained-root projections; continue eliminating the compatibility path rather than treating lookup reduction as reparse progress.

task: Project root message and enum-case shapes from retained emitter nodes.
observation: Compatibility lowering can project message and enum-case roots from the checked EmitterExpr, avoiding text-index lookups for these root shape checks.
impact: On the targeted calculator source, text-node lookups decreased 22,380 to 22,228; expression-view reparses stayed at 15,360. Generated Rust stayed byte-identical; Rust compilation, native/Fast Debug stdout parity, and checked-fact perturb/drop hooks passed.

resolution.summary: Keep node projections and continue eliminating consumer reparses; lookup-only reductions do not satisfy the parse target.

task: Project collection, index, member access, and member-call roots from retained nodes.
observation: The compatibility emitter has direct ExpressionView projections for retained root collection/index/member nodes, allowing those classifications to bypass expression-text fingerprint lookup.
impact: On the targeted calculator source, text-node lookups decreased 22,228 to 21,924. Expression-view reparses remained 15,360. Generated Rust remained byte-identical, compiled, and matched Fast Debug stdout; checked-fact hooks and feedback validation passed.

resolution.summary: Keep the retained-root projections and continue migrating expression lowering until reparses and text lookups are zero.

task: Use retained node facts for compatibility-lowering literal and empty-vector shape queries.
observation: Literal class and empty typed-vector shape can be read directly from the checked root when string compatibility lowering receives an EmitterExpr.
impact: On the targeted calculator source, text-node lookups decreased 21,924 to 21,620; reparses remained 15,360. Generated Rust was byte-identical, compiled, and matched Fast Debug stdout; checked-fact hooks and feedback validation passed.

resolution.summary: Keep direct facts for checked roots and continue migrating nested compatibility queries to node IDs.

task: Read checked numeric literal class and value from retained emitter roots.
observation: Numeric compatibility lowering can consume the checked literal node to classify integer literals and decode numeric values without re-querying by their expression text.
impact: On the targeted calculator source, text-node lookups decreased 21,620 to 21,544 while reparses remained 15,360. Generated Rust remained byte-identical, compiled, and matched Fast Debug stdout; the focused Phase 21 numeric parity test passed.

resolution.summary: Keep checked numeric projections while continuing toward zero consumer reparses and lookups.

task: Compare emitter counters against the pinned Phase 27.5.3 C1 parent.
observation: The pinned C1 parent predates text-node lookup counters. Adding the same test-only lookup counter sites to an isolated parent worktree made the focused comparison measurable without changing the candidate branch.
impact: On the same one-command calculator emission, parent c96bca78 had 181,742 reparses and 273,688 text lookups; candidate had 15,360 and 21,544 (-91.55% and -92.13%). Parent, candidate and Fast Debug stdout matched.

resolution.summary: Use this test-only parent instrumentation for continued identical-command C2 counter reports; keep it isolated from the phase branch.

task: Project compatibility-lowering binary shapes from retained checked roots.
observation: The emitter already had a node-based binary projection, but compatibility lowering sent root binary checks through the string parser. Bridging the checked node into that projection removes those text lookups.
impact: On the identical calculator command, candidate text lookups decreased 21,544 to 20,784; reparses stayed at 15,360. Pinned C1 parent with isolated matching counters is 273,688 lookups / 181,742 reparses (-92.41% / -91.55%). Generated Rust is byte-identical, compiled, and matches Fast Debug; fact hooks pass.

resolution.summary: Keep the checked binary projection and continue reducing consumer reparses; the zero target remains unmet.
